warnings: A before/after comparison does not establish causation. Independent clinicians and approximately normal paired differences are assumed. Repeated encounters must first be aggregated per clinician using a predefined rule.
Small sample: assess paired differences and study design before interpreting inference.
SIMULATED DATA: these results demonstrate the method and are not clinical evidence.
paired.report: Simulated paired data from 5 clinicians were analyzed. Mean pre-intervention and post-intervention values were 5.110 and 4.160 minutes, respectively. The mean paired difference (pre minus post) was 0.950 minutes. The 95% confidence interval was [0.888, 1.012]; two-sided paired t(4) = 42.485, p = 1.83482e-06; Cohen dz = 19.000. These results do not establish causality or changes in burnout, patient engagement, or clinical safety.

cds.note: Synthetic independent binomial groups, not live CDS Hooks telemetry. A lower override rate does not establish alert quality or clinical safety. Wilson 95% intervals assume independent alerts; real alerts may be clustered.
